title: Setup waits for the relay install and its first heartbeat
scope: Candidate source and unit tests; no production-install claim
current: Setup bounds the relay installer at 900 seconds, enough for a first served-release install on native Windows, and announces it as a designed wait. After the relay converges, fresh or already satisfied, setup polls for up to 300 seconds (a native Windows cold start first connected 116 seconds after its process started) until this machine's relay reports connected, then runs readiness. A heartbeat that has not arrived moves session-relay out of the readiness verdict into a pending entry naming `yoke relay status`, not a FAIL row; a relay already heard from keeps its doctor row. The doctor check itself never waits.
